purpose: Prove statically that the existing five C11C Suite GUI surfaces expose the operational controls needed for D9; require explicit human Windows GUI evidence before operational acceptance can close.

capabilities.label: Configuration and governed profiles
capabilities.operator_action: Open Config; inspect D9.15 read-only contract and operator profiles; verify validation/hash, diff, backup and restore controls are visible. Do not edit canonical contracts.

capabilities.label: Universal production planning and fail-closed gate
capabilities.operator_action: Create a Challenge, Visual Loop and Visual Drill plan; inspect bridge and lifecycle identities; confirm D9.14 stays BLOCKED and renderer/media stay off.

capabilities.label: Test and acceptance routes

required_controls.token: D9.14 REAL GUI PRODUCTION CERTIFICATION GATE (BLOCKED)
D9.15 GUI OPERATIONAL ACCEPTANCE PREFLIGHT (PLAN ONLY)

capabilities.operator_action: Run D9.15 preflight and the D9.13 lifecycle/D9.14 blocked-gate checks from the Test GUI; verify the printed status and logs.

capabilities.label: Catalog identity and product inspection
capabilities.operator_action: Inspect canonical intent, Producer plan and lifecycle intent projections; distinguish intent from actual pilot media and release products.

capabilities.label: Provenance, hashes and lineage
capabilities.operator_action: Inspect request, editorial, plan and lifecycle identity hashes; confirm Catalog projection is read-only and non-authoritative.

capabilities.label: Operator-visible process logs
capabilities.operator_action: Run one no-media diagnostic from Producer, Test and Maintenance; verify stdout/stderr or result text is visible and final PASS/BLOCKED state is unambiguous.

capabilities.label: Maintenance, audit and reversible safety controls
capabilities.operator_action: Run plan, docs audit, freeze preflight and lifecycle audit read-only/dry-run only; do not run APPLY or create a release archive for this acceptance.

capabilities.label: Reproduction and identity continuity
capabilities.operator_action: Repeat canonical plan resolution, compare lifecycle/request/plan hashes and inspect the Catalog reproduction command; do not claim media-level determinism without media.

operator_evidence_requirements: Operator records the exact GUI window/surface and visible result for each of the eight capabilities.
Evidence includes date/time, command/action label, final status and screenshot or copied GUI log excerpt.
Evidence is recorded only under an approved D9 acceptance evidence directory; this preflight does not write it.
No real-media case may be marked accepted by D9.15 while D9.14 remains blocked.
notes: A passing D9.15 preflight proves structural GUI readiness only; it does not constitute operator GUI acceptance.
Actual Windows GUI confirmation across all five surfaces is required before D9.15 can be marked PASS/CLOSED.
D9.14 real-media certification remains BLOCKED until a future authorized D frozen renderer baseline and explicit D4.8 governance checkpoint exist.
No GUI control or local evidence file can create production or release authority.
